en-in.title: Thai phrases to show airport staff
en-in.intro: Choose the male or female form to match the speaker, then show the Thai sentence you need to the staff member or copy it to send.
en-in.speaker: Speaker form
en-in.copyFallback: Select the Thai sentence and copy it manually.

SP-01.label: Request delay confirmation
SP-01.situation: At the counter or gate, ask about confirmation for a delayed flight.
SP-01.meaning: My booked flight has been delayed. Could I get a flight delay confirmation document?

SP-02.label: Request cancellation confirmation
SP-02.situation: At the airline counter, ask about confirmation for your cancelled flight.
SP-02.meaning: My booked flight has been cancelled. Could I get a flight cancellation confirmation document?

SP-03.label: Ask about another flight
SP-03.situation: After a cancellation or delay, ask the airline counter about changing flights.
SP-03.meaning: Could you change me to another flight?

SP-04.label: Ask how to request a refund
SP-04.situation: At the airline or ticketing counter, ask about the ticket refund procedure.
SP-04.meaning: I would like a refund for my flight ticket. What should I do?

SP-05.label: Ask about meals or accommodation
SP-05.situation: During a long delay, ask airline staff whether meals or accommodation are provided.
SP-05.meaning: The flight has been delayed for a long time. Does the airline provide meals or accommodation for passengers?

SP-06.label: Ask where to report baggage damage
SP-06.situation: After finding damage to your arriving bag, ask baggage staff where to report it and request a PIR.
SP-06.meaning: My suitcase has been damaged. Where should I go to report the problem and request a PIR document?
